# Sanitised nRF52840 (PBX) console capture, used as a parser fixture.
#
# Derived from a real session: two phones registering, exchanging messages
# in both directions, then disconnecting. Phone numbers were remapped to
# synthetic ones CONSISTENTLY, so the fromnum sequences and the ROUTE header
# ids still line up and remain testable; message content and hexdump bytes
# are redacted. The raw capture is gitignored under captures/ because it
# carries real numbers and real message text.
#
# ANSI escapes are stripped, matching what ConsoleReader hands the parser.
# What is NOT here: any congestion event (TX queue full, RX overrun, phone
# queue full). The session had none, so those patterns remain unverified
# against observed data.
